text: Prince Nirajan Bir Bikram Shah Dev (Nepali: निराजन बीर विक्रम शाह; 6 November 1978 – 1 June 2001) was a member of the Nepalese royal family, the younger son of King Birendra and Queen Aishwarya. He was killed during the Nepalese royal massacre on 1 June 2001, along with his father, mother, sister, brother, and other close royal relatives. He received his education at Budhanilkantha School in Kathmandu and Eton College, and earned a B.B.A. degree from Kathmandu College of Management. He had a particular interest in sports, especially swimming. The name Nirajan means "One without fault; perfect in all forms." This biography of a member of a Nepalese royal house is a stub.
